Stockmannin uusi jouluikkuna on saanut osakseen voimakasta arvostelua. Sosiaalisessa mediassa sitä on kuvailtu muun muassa ankeaksi, rumaksi ja epäjouluiseksi. items.title: Mene lääkäriin heti, jos huomaat nämä oireet
items.summary: Iäkkäillä matala verenpaine voi aiheuttaa oireita, jotka huolestuttavat ja aiheuttavat esimerkiksi kaatumisvaaran. Joskus taustalta löytyykin sairaus. Nyrkkisääntönä voidaan sanoa, että terveen, vointinsa hyväksi tuntevan henkilön, jolla verenpaineen yläpaine on 100 millimetriä elohopeaa (mmHg) tai jopa alhaisempi, ei tarvitse olla matalasta verenpaineesta huolissaan. Lukemaa tärkeämpää on ottaa huomioon mahdolliset matalan verenpaineen aiheuttamat oireet. items.title: FORGE Lab uses agentic tools to identify memory safety issues in Rust
items.summary: Microsoft’s FORGE Lab found several memory safety issues in Rust’s standard library (std and core), including cases where code written entirely in safe Rust can trigger undefined behavior. The research used Hyenas, FORGE’s frontier research version of codename MDASH, an AI-powered vulnerability-scanning system. The findings reveal three recurring patterns of misplaced trust in unsafe code: trusting code not to panic, trusting user-provided implementations to be correct, and trusting the underlying system. Rust’s safety guarantees are precisely what make these findings interesting. Its rich typ…

items.title: Trusted by Default: Qubole Cross-Account Access Abused in the Wild
items.summary: Third-party integrations are one of the most common ways organizations grant outside parties access to their cloud environments. Working with Sentra and Mandiant, Wiz observed a threat actor using IAM credentials from an AWS account associated with Qubole between October 14 and October 26, 2026. The actor used these credentials to assume IAM roles that customers had created to trust Qubole's account. Once inside multiple victim AWS environments, the threat actor enumerated resources, collected configuration and secrets, accessed S3 data, and validated additional credentials it discovered along…

items.title: Hacking Two Automakers: ForgeRock Path Confusion, RCE, and Remote Vehicle Access
items.summary: In early 2026, Shubham Shah and I found a vulnerability chain that gave us remote code execution on the production ForgeRock servers handling customer logins for two automakers, which we'll call Automaker #1 and Automaker #2. From those servers, we could create a valid session for any customer account managed by the affected deployments. If the account had a connected vehicle, the session gave us the same remote access as the owner's app: its location and telemetry, door lock and unlock, and remote engine start and stop. After we reported the vulnerability, both automakers fixed it within abou…

items.title: Linus Torvalds sees signs AI-prompted patch flood has peaked
items.summary: The worst of the patchpocalypse may be behind us, according to Linus Torvalds. Writing in his weekly kernel update post, the Linux kernel dev leader delivered Linux 7.4 rc2 – the second rough cut of the next kernel – which he rated as a big release for two reasons. One is that he left some code out of rc1, because he was busy and because it was already the largest such release in the history of the kernel. items.title: Pro-Russian hackers target European officials, offer rewards for personal information
items.summary: Pro-Russian hackers have published the personal information of Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani and other senior European officials on the dark web, offering cryptocurrency rewards for additional details about them and their families. items.title: Portal breach at Germany's top university exposes every registered user's password
items.summary: Attackers stole central university login passwords belonging to everyone registered with the Technical University of Munich's myTUM portal, including an admin whose credentials were then used to attack a second system. The initial attack targeted the myTUM portal, which serves students and faculty members, providing centralized online access to services and documents.
